name: kalandra-native
description: Native Kalandra language support for .k files.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The native language server launches a configured executable. Trust the workspace to enable it.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The native compiler currently requires local file paths.

commands.title: Kalandra: Show Native Language Server Output

kalandra.native.serverPath.description: Absolute path to kalandra-lsp, or its executable name on PATH. No shell commands or relative executable paths. Requires a native server build.

kalandra.native.projectPath.description: Optional native project manifest (.toml). Relative paths require a single workspace folder. One manifest supplies package mappings for this window; leave empty for relative-import source roots.

kalandra.native.placement.description: Enable CPU/Metal placement checking. Does not run code or guarantee GPU lowering.

scripts.test: bun test test/config.test.cjs test/grammar.test.cjs && bun test test/lifecycle.test.cjs
